html:
The Maijabi, or Mayi-Yapi, were an Aboriginal Australian people of northwest Queensland, in the country between Cloncurry and the Gulf of Carpentaria.

They spoke one of the Mayi languages, now extinct. Their neighbours were the Mayi-Kutuna, Maithakari, Kukatj and Maikulan. Cattle stations and copper mining reached this area in the 1860s and 1870s, and little else is recorded.
sum: The Maijabi, or Mayi-Yapi, were an Aboriginal Australian people of northwest Queensland, in the country between Cloncurry and the Gulf of Carpentaria.
